description: A maximalist, retro-pop bedroom or living corner drenched in bright saturated color. A low pink side table with a glossy lacquered finish and an open lower shelf sits at center left, its surface holding a colorful abstract art magazine, a pink-tinted ribbed drinking glass, and a small daisy-shaped ceramic vase with a lime green stem. On the lower shelf are stacked books including brightly titled volumes. A large pink-framed art print leans on the table, its bold orange-red typography reading partially as "THIS MUST BE THE PLACE." To the right, a plush sofa or chair is draped in a yellow and white check-pattern fabric throw blanket, and a round pink tufted cushion rests against it. A large tropical plant peeks in from the upper right behind the sofa, its green leaves framed by a bright window. The wall behind is a warm off-white cream. Warm white light emanates from an articulated object on the table surface — a glossy orange arched adjustable form on a cream base with a round orange dot button — casting a bright cone of warm illumination downward onto the table surface. The palette is entirely saturated retro-pop: bubblegum pink, vivid orange, mustard yellow, and lime green against a cream backdrop. The atmosphere is maximalist, joyful, and emphatically youthful. Camera at approximately seated eye-level, roughly 3 feet, with a normal to slightly wide lens and a tight vignette composition framing the table surface at near-center while the sofa fills the right half and the wall print dominates the left background. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
